reason: I already reorder my Toplux when it runs out and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $25 to $30 a month for one thing I don't know is not in my budget.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? For $30 I'd want more in it, and I have no reason to leave what I already take.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 a month, or a sample I could try first, plus a plain reason why bisglycinate alone beats the 8-form blends.
